name: Declasse Tulip
summary: Classic 4-door American muscle car boasting high-torque V8 acceleration, deep exhaust rumble, and nostalgic 1970s aesthetics.
description: Featured prominently in official trailer footage speeding down Vice City boulevards with Lucia and Jason inside, the Declasse Tulip is modeled after the 1972 Chevrolet Chevelle Malibu. Combining heavy rear-wheel-drive drift capability with enough seating for a 4-person getaway crew, it serves as Lucia and Jason's primary early-game wheels.

seo.title: Declasse Tulip: Getaway Specs, Tuning & Locations
seo.description: Complete vehicle guide for the Declasse Tulip in GTA VI. Lucia and Jason's signature muscle getaway car, V8 engine mods, and handling.
